Panzer IV, T-34, Sherman, Tiger, Panther: Panzer IV, T-34, Sherman, Tiger, Panther, IS-2 and the Argentine Nahuel: the tanks that decided the war, from Libya to Berlin.
El tanque de la Blitzkrieg con el 5 cm K: The Blitzkrieg tank with the 5 cm KwK 38: five crew, radio and a commander's cupola. In the desert and in Russia it fought everything it met.
El Panzer IV con el cañón largo de 75 mm: The Panzer IV with the long 75 mm L/43 gun: the first German tank that could penetrate the T-34 and KV from the front. The British called it the "Mark IV Special".
Cañón de asalto sin torre sobre el chasi: Turretless assault gun on the Panzer III chassis: low, 80 mm of frontal armor and the 75 mm L/48. The most produced German armored vehicle of the war. You have to turn the whole vehicle to aim.
El Panzer IV definitivo: 80 mm de frente: The definitive Panzer IV: 80 mm frontal armor, 75 mm L/48 and steel side skirts (Schürzen) against Soviet anti-tank rifles. The backbone of the Panzer divisions.
La respuesta al T-34: glacis de 80 mm a: The answer to the T-34: an 80 mm glacis at 55° that almost nothing penetrates from the front and the 75 mm L/70, one of the best guns of the war. Fast, but with thin sides and a fragile transmission.
El tanque más temido: 100 mm de frente p: The most feared tank: 100 mm of flat frontal armor and the 8.8 cm KwK 36 that destroyed any Allied tank beyond a kilometer. Slow, heavy (57 t) and hard to maintain.
Tanque ligero barato y fácil de fabricar: Cheap light tank, easy to build with truck engines: a 45 mm gun and 45 mm of sloped frontal armor. The commander is also the loader and the gunner.
El tanque que cambió la guerra: blindaje: The tank that changed the war: sloped armor, wide tracks for the mud, a diesel engine and the 76 mm F-34. In 1941 the Germans had nothing to penetrate it from the front.
El tanque pesado soviético: 75 mm por to: The Soviet heavy tank: 75 mm all around and extra welded armor. At Raseiniai a single one held up a Panzer division for an entire day.
El T-34 con torre fundida de tres tripul: The T-34 with a three-man cast turret and the 85 mm ZiS-S-53: it penetrates the Tiger from the front at short range. The tank that reached Berlin.
\"Iósif Stalin\": el 122 mm D-25T, un ca: "Joseph Stalin": the 122 mm D-25T, an artillery gun that wrecks any German tank even without penetrating. Slow two-piece loading, 120 mm of sloped frontal armor.
El \"Honey\" de los británicos en Libia:: The British "Honey" in Libya: fast, reliable and armed with the 37 mm M6. Light and agile; its armor can't stand up to the Panzers.
El tanque aliado más fabricado: casco fu: The most produced Allied tank: rounded cast hull, 75 mm M3 with a good HE round and a vertical stabilizer. Reliable and easy to repair.
Cazatanques sobre chasis de Sherman con: Tank destroyer on a Sherman chassis with the 3 in M7 in an open-topped turret: it penetrates the Panzer IV at long range, but the crew is exposed to artillery.
El mejor Sherman: torre grande con el 76: The best Sherman: a large turret with the 76 mm M1 and HVSS suspension that makes it much smoother and faster cross-country. Penetrates the Panther from the side and the Panzer IV from the front.
El tanque pesado que llegó al final: 90: The heavy tank that arrived at the end: 90 mm M3, 102 mm of sloped frontal armor and torsion-bar suspension. In Cologne (March 1945) it destroyed a Panther in a filmed duel.
\"La reina del desierto\": 78 mm de blin: "Queen of the Desert": 78 mm of cast armor that no Italian or German gun of 1940 could penetrate. Very slow and armed with the 40 mm 2-pounder, without HE.
Crucero rápido de Christie con el 6 libr: Fast Christie cruiser with the 57 mm 6-pounder: it penetrates Panzer IIIs and IVs from the front. At El Alamein it led the armored brigades. Thin armor and unreliable.
El crucero más rápido de la guerra: 64 k: The fastest cruiser of the war: 64 km/h with the Meteor engine (a Rolls-Royce Merlin aircraft engine) and a 75 mm gun. Its strength is flanking; head-on it doesn't hold up long.
Tanque de infantería con 152 mm de frent: Infantry tank with 152 mm of frontal armor: it climbs slopes no other tank can and withstands almost everything except the 88. Slow as a walking man, which is exactly what it had to escort.
Un Sherman con el 17 libras metido a pre: A Sherman with the 17-pounder squeezed in: the only Allied tank of 1944 that could penetrate the Tiger and Panther from the front. The long barrel gave it away: the Germans shot it first.
El primer tanque argentino, diseñado por: The first Argentine tank, designed by Colonel Alfredo Baisi and built at the Esteban de Luca Arsenal in the middle of the war, when no one would sell us armor. 35 t, an 80 mm glacis at 55° (more than the Sherman's), a cast turret and the low-velocity 1909 Krupp 75 mm artillery gun. A 12-cylinder Lorraine-Dietrich aircraft engine. 12 were built.
El antitanque alemán estándar desde 1942: The standard German anti-tank gun from 1942: it penetrates any T-34 or Sherman.
El cañón divisional soviético: liviano,: The Soviet divisional gun: light, accurate and good against everything.
El antitanque británico de 57 mm de El A: The British 57 mm anti-tank gun from El Alamein onward.
La versión estadounidense del 6 libras b: The American version of the British 6-pounder.
El antitanque sueco que compró el Ejérci: The Swedish anti-tank gun bought by the Argentine Army in the 1930s.
Tanque checoslovaco que Alemania se qued: Czechoslovak tank that Germany took over in 1939: reliable, riveted and armed with the 37 mm KwK 38(t). A third of the Panzers that invaded France were Czech.
El mejor cazatanques de la guerra: el 8,: The best tank destroyer of the war: the Tiger II's 8.8 cm L/71 on the Panther chassis, with a one-piece casemate sloped at 55°. Fast, low and deadly at two kilometers.
El \"Tigre Real\": 69 toneladas, 150 mm: The "King Tiger": 69 tonnes, 150 mm of sloped frontal armor and the 8.8 cm KwK 43 L/71, which penetrates any Allied tank at any range. It guzzles fuel and breaks down often.
El último de los \"tanques rápidos\" de: The last of Christie's "fast tanks": 52 km/h on tracks, a cylindrical turret with the 45 mm 20-K. In 1941 there were thousands and almost all were lost in the first months.
Un obús de 152 mm en una torre enorme so: A 152 mm howitzer in a huge turret on the KV-1 chassis. Meant for cracking bunkers; against tanks, a well-placed shot wrecks them even without penetrating. Very slow loading and the turret turns slowly.
Cazatanques sobre el chasis del T-34 con: Tank destroyer on the T-34 chassis with the 100 mm D-10S, a naval gun that penetrates the Panther from the front. Sloped casemate and a commander's cupola with periscopes.
El blindado de orugas más rápido de la g: The fastest tracked armored vehicle of the war: 80 km/h, with the 76 mm M1 in an open turret. Its doctrine: get there first, shoot and disappear. The armor is almost symbolic.
El reemplazo del Stuart: el 75 mm livian: The Stuart's replacement: the light 75 mm from B-25 bombers in an 18 t tank with torsion bars. Fast, comfortable for the crew and accurate.
El cazatanques estadounidense con el 90: The American tank destroyer with the 90 mm M3: the only one that could penetrate the Panther from the front at range. Open-topped cast turret on the M10 chassis.
Tanque de infantería chico, barato y con: Small, cheap and reliable infantry tank: over 8,000 were built and thousands went to the USSR. The Mk IX carries the 57 mm 6-pounder in a two-man turret.
El mejor tanque británico de la guerra:: The best British tank of the war: the 77 mm HV (a shortened 17-pounder) in a reinforced Cromwell hull, with Christie suspension and return rollers. It arrived in time to cross the Rhine.
El M10 estadounidense rearmado por los b: The American M10 rearmed by the British with the 17-pounder: the counterweight at the muzzle gives it away. It penetrates the Panther from the side at any range and from the front up close.
Vickers 6 toneladas, T-26, M3A3 Stuart y: Vickers 6-ton, T-26, M3A3 Stuart and M4A4 Sherman.
Tanque ligero italiano de reconocimiento: Italian light reconnaissance tank with a 20 mm Breda autocannon. Small, fast and thinly armored: it fights from afar and leaves.
El tanque medio italiano del desierto: r: The Italian desert medium tank: riveted, with the 47/32 that penetrates Crusaders and Stuarts. In Libya it fought the Matilda, which it could hardly penetrate.
Cañón de asalto sobre el chasis del M13:: Assault gun on the M13 chassis: a short 75 mm howitzer with shaped-charge ammo that penetrated the Shermans and Grants at El Alamein. Low and hard to spot.
El \"pesado\" italiano: 75/34 y blindaje: The Italian "heavy": 75/34 and sloped armor like the T-34. It came too late: almost all of them were used by the Germans after the 1943 armistice.
El tanque ligero japonés más fabricado:: The most produced Japanese light tank: 37 mm gun, 12 mm armor and the commander alone in the turret. Very good in China and the Malayan jungle; against Stuarts and Shermans, not much.
El Chi-Ha con la \"torre nueva\" (shinho: The Chi-Ha with the "new turret" (shinhoto) and the 47 mm Type 1, a high-velocity gun that could finally penetrate the Stuart and the M3 Lee from the side.
El Chi-Ha mejorado: soldado en vez de re: The improved Chi-Ha: welded instead of riveted, 50 mm frontal armor, a stronger engine and a radio. The 47 mm Type 1 penetrates the Sherman only up close and from the side.
El tanque que Japón guardó para defender: The tank Japan kept back to defend the home islands: the Type 90 75 mm field gun in a large turret, able to penetrate the Sherman. It never saw combat.
Tanque ligero de caballería con casco fu: Cavalry light tank with a 40 mm cast hull and the long-barreled 37 mm SA38. Well armored for 1940, but the commander does everything alone in the turret.
El mejor tanque de mayo de 1940: casco f: The best tank of May 1940: a 47 mm cast hull and the 47 mm SA35 that penetrated any Panzer. At Hannut and Gembloux it held up the Wehrmacht for a few days.
La fortaleza francesa: 60 mm de blindaje: The French fortress: 60 mm of armor, a 47 mm gun in the turret and a 75 mm howitzer in the hull. At Stonne, Captain Billotte's "Eure" destroyed 13 Panzers without being penetrated.
Los Sherman de la 2.ª División Blindada: The Shermans of General Leclerc's 2nd Armored Division, the first to enter Paris on August 24, 1944. Each tank bore a name: "Romilly", "Montmirail", "Champaubert".
El Ejército Nacional Revolucionario comp: The National Revolutionary Army bought 20 Vickers with the short 47 mm. They fought the Japanese in Shanghai in 1937 and almost all were lost.
Los 82 T-26 que la URSS mandó a China en: The 82 T-26s the USSR sent to China in 1938: the 45 mm penetrated any Japanese tank. They formed the 200th Division, China's first armored division.
Stuart con casco inclinado del 1.er Grup: Sloped-hull Stuart of the Sino-American 1st Provisional Tank Group, which fought in the Burmese jungle in 1944 to reopen the road to China.
Los Sherman chinos de Birmania (1945): c: The Chinese Shermans of Burma (1945): with them the Chinese Army in India opened the Ledo Road to Yunnan. The 75 mm destroyed any Japanese tank.
El antitanque y cañón de acompañamiento: The Italian anti-tank and infantry support gun.
El antitanque francés de 1940, de los me: The French anti-tank gun of 1940, one of the best of its time.
Los antitanques alemanes que compró Chin: The German anti-tank guns China bought before the war.
El semioruga de los Panzergrenadier: lle: The Panzergrenadiers' half-track: it carries 10 soldiers and a shielded MG 34.
El semioruga aliado: lo usaron Estados U: The Allied half-track: used by the United States, the United Kingdom and the USSR. It carries a squad and a heavy machine gun.
El antiaéreo liviano alemán: 20 mm autom: The German light anti-aircraft gun: automatic 20 mm, also terrible against infantry.
El antiaéreo aliado por excelencia, de f: The Allied anti-aircraft gun par excellence, Swedish-made: automatic 40 mm in 4-round clips.
Chasis de Panzer IV con una torre abiert: Panzer IV chassis with an open nine-sided turret and the Flakvierling: four 20 mm cannons. About 100 built to protect the Panzer divisions from Allied fighter-bombers.
El sucesor del Wirbelwind: un 3,7 cm Fla: The Wirbelwind's successor: a 3.7 cm Flak 43 in an open turret on the Panzer IV. More range and a round that also penetrates light armor.
El primer antiaéreo autopropulsado sovié: The first Soviet self-propelled anti-aircraft gun: the automatic 37 mm 61-K in an open casemate on the SU-76M chassis. It arrived in the last months of the war.
El semioruga M3 con el montaje Maxson M4: The M3 half-track with the Maxson M45 mount: four 12.7 mm machine guns. Against infantry it was called "the meat chopper".
Crusader con una torre abierta y dos Oer: Crusader with an open turret and two 20 mm Oerlikons. Prepared for D-Day; since the Allies ruled the skies, many ended up firing at infantry.
Prototipo japonés: el cañón automático d: Japanese prototype: the Type 98 20 mm autocannon on a light Ke-Ni chassis, with a shield and no roof. Light, fast and nearly unarmored.
Cada zona en manos enemigas descuenta ti: Each zone in enemy hands drains your team's tickets.
